sections.title: VENDOR DETAILS  (single search on vendor code or name - every other field is pulled from the vendor register and is read-only)
BILL LINE ITEMS  (repeating block - unlimited lines)

fields.validation: STAGE 1 - DIARY. Type-ahead search on vendor code OR registered name against the vendor register; the user must pick an existing active record. This single selection populates the whole of Section 2. No manual vendor entry anywhere on the form.
STAGE 1 - DIARY. Number printed on the vendor's own document; must be unique per vendor per financial year. A duplicate is rejected at diary stage, before the document is accepted from the vendor.

STAGE 1 - DIARY. Auto-generated on save as soon as fields 1.1 and 1.2 are entered; unique, gapless and immutable (e.g. SSIT-DRY-2026-001188). This is the acknowledgement reference shared with the vendor and quoted in every later query. It is NOT the bill booking number in field 1.7.
STAGE 1 - DIARY. Stamped when the diary record is saved; starts the bill turnaround clock and cannot be back-dated.

STAGE 1 - DIARY. Acknowledgement carrying the diary number, vendor name, vendor bill number and diary date is sent to the vendor contact and printable as a bill-receipt slip; it is the vendor's proof of submission and confers no approval.

Diary - awaiting completion / Completed - under verification / Cancelled. The record is saved and shareable at Diary stage with fields 1.1 to 1.5 only. All Stage-2 data (bill type, dates, cost centre, amounts, taxes and references) may be added later and ALTERED BY MANAGEMENT while the status is Diary or Pending verification; every change is written to the system audit log. Once the bill is Approved no field can be edited - only reversed by credit note.

STAGE 2. Auto-generated on completion of the header, unique and immutable, using the enterprise document prefix (e.g. SSIT-BILL-2026-00145). Issued once the diary record is completed; the diary number in field 1.3 stays linked to it for the vendor's reference.

Purchase bill (goods) / Freight bill (transport) / Fuel bill / Maintenance or repair bill / Spare parts, tyres & consumables bill / Vehicle or equipment hire bill / Insurance bill / Service bill / Utility bill / Debit note. Drives which reference and tax fields are mandatory. Tax, government fee and staff salary payments are NOT booked on this form.
Date the bill is entered in the ERP; cannot be earlier than the vendor's bill date.
Date printed on the vendor's document; must fall inside an open accounting period.
Derived from the booking date; the bill is rejected if the period is closed.
PKR (default) / USD / EUR - must match the vendor's registered currency.
Required for foreign currency bills; SBP or contractual rate on the bill date.
Buying entity from sheet 01; determines the tax registration used.

fields.field: Business location / plant receiving the supply
fields.validation: Determines the provincial tax jurisdiction applied.

fields.field: Cost centre / department to be charged
fields.validation: STAGE 2 - alterable by management until the bill is approved. General ledger cost centre to which the expense or inventory is posted.
Required where the enterprise operates project accounting.
Physical or electronic receipt date; starts the payment-term clock.

Diary - awaiting completion / Draft / Pending verification / Matched / On hold / Approved / Partially paid / Paid / Rejected / Cancelled. A record sits at Diary from the moment the diary number is issued until the Stage-2 header is completed.

NO MANUAL ENTRY. Derived from the vendor record selected in field 2.2: Manufacturer (sheet 02) / Distributor (sheet 03) / Transporter (sheet 05) / Fuel supplier / Workshop or maintenance vendor / Spare parts & tyre supplier / Vehicle or equipment hire vendor / Insurance company / Service vendor / Utility. Every payee must exist in the vendor register before a bill can be booked.

THE ONLY SEARCHABLE FIELD IN THIS SECTION. Type-ahead search on vendor code OR registered name against the vendor register; the user must pick an existing active record. Selecting it populates fields 2.1 and 2.3 to 2.12 automatically. Free-text entry of a new vendor is not permitted here - unregistered vendors must first be onboarded on sheet 02, 03 or 05.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the vendor master; a mismatch against the NTN printed on the bill blocks booking.

fields.field: Vendor filer status on the bill date
fields.validation: NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the vendor master as at the bill date; if the ATL validity has lapsed the system applies non-filer withholding rates.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the vendor's Withholding Tax Exemption section; the exemption rate is applied only where the bill date falls within its validity, otherwise normal rates apply.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Contact selected from the points-of-contact block of the vendor record; where the record holds several contacts the user picks one from that list only.

NO MANUAL ENTRY. Defaults to the account flagged primary on the vendor record; where the vendor holds several verified accounts the user selects from that list only. Unverified accounts are not offered and block payment release.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the vendor contract (Advance / COD / Net 15 / Net 30 / Net 45 / LC); an override requires finance approval and is logged.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Advances and credit notes available for adjustment against this bill, computed from the vendor ledger.
Mandatory for purchase and service bills; the bill cannot exceed the PO value beyond the tolerance.
Pulled from the purchase order; the billed value is checked against it within the enterprise tolerance.
Master supply or transport agreement governing the rate.
REPEATING BLOCK - unlimited lines per bill.
From the material definition sheet; mandatory for goods bills.
Description as printed on the vendor's bill.
fields.sampleEntry: Ordinary Portland Cement 53 Grade, 50 kg PP bag

fields.validation: MT / Kg / Bag / Litre / Piece / Set / Kilometre / Trip / Job / Hour / Day / Lump sum.
Quantity billed by the vendor; checked against the goods receipt note(s) referenced in Section 3 within tolerance.
Quantity accepted after any deduction; this is the payable quantity.
Must match the purchase order or contract rate within tolerance.
Quantity accepted multiplied by the rate.
Gross line amount; the base for sales tax and any other tax on the line.
Standard rate or the rate applicable to the PCT heading.
Applies to cement and other excisable goods.
Sum of the taxable value of all lines.
Applied automatically where the vendor is unregistered for sales tax.
Section 153 goods, services or transport rate, set by the vendor's filer status on the bill date.
Withheld from the payment and deposited with the FBR by the due date.
Certificate reference and reduced rate used; blank if no valid certificate exists on the bill date.
Total tax charged by the vendor on the bill.
Income tax withheld by the enterprise; reduces the amount payable to the vendor.

fields.field: WHT deposit due date & CPR reference
fields.validation: Statutory deposit deadline and the FBR payment receipt number once paid.

fields.field: Withholding tax certificate issued to vendor
fields.validation: Certificate must be issued to the vendor after deposit.
Site handling charges recoverable under the contract.
Liquidated damages applied under the contract.
Advance previously paid to the vendor, adjusted against this bill.
Retention held under the contract, released on completion.
Rounds the payable amount to the nearest rupee.
Total taxable value of all lines.

fields.field: Add: total taxes charged by vendor (PKR)
fields.validation: From field 5.7.
Handling and other charges from field 6.1.
Value plus taxes plus charges; must equal the total printed on the vendor's bill.
From field 5.8.
Sum of fields 6.2, 6.3 and 6.4.
Bill gross total less withholding less deductions, after rounding.
Generated automatically from the net payable amount.
fields.sampleEntry: Rupees five million two hundred fifteen thousand six hundred thirty eight only

fields.validation: Sum of payment vouchers posted against this bill.
Net payable less amount paid to date; drives the ageing report.

fields.field: Input tax claimed in which sales tax return
fields.validation: Tax period in which the input tax is claimed; must be within the permitted claim window.
Defaults from the payment terms on the vendor contract; an override requires finance approval and is logged.
Bill received date plus the credit period; drives the payables ageing bucket.
Date proposed in the payment run; must not be later than the due date without approval.
Online transfer (RTGS / IBFT) / Cheque / Pay order / Letter of credit / Cash.
Normal / Urgent / Hold - urgent payments require additional approval.
Mandatory where the bill status is On hold; visible to the vendor portal.
Whether the bill may be settled in instalments.
Vouchers raised against this bill; links to the payment voucher sheet.
Officer who checked the vendor bill against the purchase order and the quantity received before approval.

Approver as per the delegation of authority. Approval sets the bill status in field 1.19 to Approved - the only status that allows a payment voucher to be raised on sheet 10. Approved bills cannot be edited, only reversed by credit note.
